# Ehrcalc CLI Reference

This reference is generated from the `clap` command model. It is the source-of-truth command reference; the README provides the higher-level project overview.

## Top-Level Usage

```text
Ehrcalc computes Ehrhart polynomials, h*-vectors, dimensions, and related exact combinatorial data.

Every computational command uses exact arbitrary-size integers and rationals. The JSON format is the stable machine-readable contract; formula-producing commands also support LaTeX.

Usage: ehrcalc [COMMAND]

Commands:
  gt           Compute Gelfand-Tsetlin Ehrhart, h*, and dimension data
  kostka       Compute Kostka, skew Kostka, and flagged Kostka coefficients
  lr           Compute a Littlewood-Richardson coefficient
  key          Compute key-polynomial Ehrhart families from Kogan faces
  order        Compute order-polytope Ehrhart, h*, and dimension data
  flow         Compute acyclic flow-polytope Ehrhart, h*, and dimension data
  interpolate  Interpolate an exact polynomial from distinct integral sample points
  hstar        Convert exact Ehrhart data to or from an h* numerator
  binomial     Convert between the power basis and standard binomial basis
  delta        Compute the finite difference of an exact polynomial
  sum          Compute the discrete sum of an integer-valued polynomial
  eval         Evaluate an exact polynomial at an integral argument
  verify       Verify an exact polynomial against one independently supplied value
  docs         Render generated documentation from the command model
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version

Use `ehrcalc <command> --help` for exact input syntax and examples.

For generated Markdown command documentation, run `ehrcalc docs cli`.

```

## Commands

### `ehrcalc gt`

```text
Compute Gelfand-Tsetlin Ehrhart, h*, and dimension data

Usage: gt [OPTIONS] --lambda <LAMBDA> --weight <WEIGHT>

Options:
      --lambda <LAMBDA>
          Outer partition, for example `4,3,1`

      --mu <MU>
          Optional inner partition for a skew shape
          
          [default: ""]

      --weight <WEIGHT>
          Weight composition, for example `2,2,1`

      --upper-flags <UPPER_FLAGS>
          Per-label upper row flags

      --lower-flags <LOWER_FLAGS>
          Per-label lower row flags

      --max-states <MAX_STATES>
          Abort the underlying DP if a level has more than this many states

      --positive-only
          Use only nonnegative dilation samples instead of reciprocity

      --format <FORMAT>
          Render as human-readable text, stable JSON, or LaTeX formulas
          
          [default: text]
          [possible values: text, json, latex]

  -h, --help
          Print help

```

### `ehrcalc key`

```text
Compute key-polynomial Ehrhart families from Kogan faces

Usage: key [OPTIONS] --lambda <LAMBDA> --sigma <SIGMA>

Options:
      --lambda <LAMBDA>
          Dominant partition lambda

      --sigma <SIGMA>
          One-based permutation, for example `2,4,5,3,1`

      --max-degree <MAX_DEGREE>
          A proven degree bound; the default is the full GT bound

      --format <FORMAT>
          Render as human-readable text, stable JSON, or LaTeX formulas
          
          [default: text]
          [possible values: text, json, latex]

  -h, --help
          Print help

```

### `ehrcalc order`

```text
Compute order-polytope Ehrhart, h*, and dimension data

Usage: order [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --chain <CHAIN>
          Construct the chain on this many elements

      --antichain <ANTICHAIN>
          Construct the antichain on this many elements

      --fence <FENCE>
          Construct the fence on this many elements

      --shape <SHAPE>
          Construct the Ferrers-poset order polytope of this partition shape

      --vertices <VERTICES>
          Number of vertices for an explicit cover-relation input

      --covers <COVERS>
          Comma-separated zero-based covers, for example `0<1,0<2,1<3,2<3`

      --format <FORMAT>
          Render as human-readable text, stable JSON, or LaTeX formulas
          
          [default: text]
          [possible values: text, json, latex]

  -h, --help
          Print help

```

### `ehrcalc flow`

```text
Compute acyclic flow-polytope Ehrhart, h*, and dimension data

Usage: flow [OPTIONS] --vertices <VERTICES> --edges <EDGES> --netflow <NETFLOW>

Options:
      --vertices <VERTICES>
          Number of zero-based graph vertices

      --edges <EDGES>
          Comma-separated directed edges, for example `0->1,0->2,1->3,2->3`

      --netflow <NETFLOW>
          Comma-separated netflow vector whose entries sum to zero

      --max-states <MAX_STATES>
          Abort the underlying DP if it exceeds this many states

      --positive-only
          Use only nonnegative dilation samples instead of reciprocity

      --format <FORMAT>
          Render as human-readable text, stable JSON, or LaTeX formulas
          
          [default: text]
          [possible values: text, json, latex]

  -h, --help
          Print help

```
